mapper.select: INSERT INTO daily_goals ( user_id, goal_type, calorie_intake_goal, exercise_calorie_goal, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{goalType}, #{calorieIntakeGoal}, #{exerciseCalorieGoal}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET goal_type = EXCLUDED.goal_type, calorie_intake_goal = EXCLUDED.calorie_intake_goal, exercise_calorie_goal = EXCLUDED.exercise_calorie_goal, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id, user_id, goal_type, calorie_intake_goal, exercise_calorie_goal, created_at, updated_at
